notes.title: Version 1.3.0 - ultrawide support, UI improvements, and more!
notes.content:
Version 1.3.0 is here!
- Ultrawide support added (go to the Options menu and select a different resolution)
- WASD controls added
- Enemy HP bars are now visible
- Minor UI improvements implemented
- Minor character changes
- Multiple little bug fixes

See more of the map in Ultrawide resolution:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40374774/b25fdd0bacc4a0ad3b0ba860f9248b33eaf8041c.png[/img]

See how much fight your debate opponents have left:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40374774/39a434949802b716af5b250202f91613545d5f88.png[/img]

notes.title: The DOORS update is live!
notes.content:
HAPPY EARTH DAY! The DOORS update is live! Every door is accessible within the game now. Who knows what will happen when you pass through each house's entryway?

Update to version 1.1.0 today to experience a bit more of the land of Gaia. Villagers will be seen wandering around their homes or inside buildings, unless they're already following you around!

notes.title: Anti-Science Brigade Releases!
notes.content:
Anti-Science Brigade releases today! Enjoy 15% off before September 13.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1221730/ss_f1184098cd5cdb20d83ceb7bfeaca722a37618f8.600x338.jpg[/img]

It also happens to be International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies! More info can be found here: https://www.cleanairblueskies.org/

A reminder that 50% of profits go to National Center for Science Education. Find out more about the NCSE here: https://ncse.ngo/

You also might notice that some of the doors in town are LOCKED. These will open up in the coming weeks with game updates!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40374774/507b5d6fc5f26319254efa4ed4a24dc611c59237.png[/img]

~ Enjoy
